description: Returns the currency configuration for the specified company. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated, so consumers can detect the unconfigured state without a 404.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore company. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies. Identifies which company's currency configuration to act on.
